text:
maria_cs: Ping  New customer Orbit is seeing short 429 spikes during onboarding when their test harness fires ~16 parallel SDK inits. Happens ~700ms after session create.
kevin_engineer: any SDK logs?
maria_cs: customer pasted this minimal trace:
```
POST /v1/sessions -> 200
send-header: x-orbit-meta=v1;env=staging;session=ooo
POST /v1/respond -> 429 rate_limit
```
rachel_sre: Same pattern as header-based consistent-hash hotspot. If x-orbit-meta ended up in hash keys it can funnel identical values to one upstream shard.
tom_infra: we did a narrow LB tweak last week that added a couple headers for affinity. i'll check if x-orbit-meta is included in any active pools.
kevin_engineer: quick mitigations: (A) infra: tenant-scoped edge rule to drop x-orbit-meta from hash input for orbit-tenant; canary first, timebox; (B) SDK: tiny patch to avoid attaching the header on blocking init and emit it async with jitter; (C) ask Orbit to reduce parallel inits while we canary.
ops-bot: PR-9999 created for tenant-scoped edge rule; canary=5% queued.
tom_infra: canary started. monitoring per-upstream queue and error-rate.
maria_cs: Orbit agreed to throttle to 6 concurrent for 30m and join a quick call in 10m. i'll paste any failing req ids after the call. :thumbsup:
